svg.title: About Felix
svg.desc: AI/ML Engineer and BNSP-certified Data Scientist in Jakarta, focused on GenAI, RAG, LLM fine-tuning, NLP, and computer vision. Builds production systems and has published research.

path.aria-label: AI/ML Engineer and BNSP-certified Data Scientist, focused on GenAI, RAG, LLM fine-tuning, NLP, and computer vision.
Currently building production RAG systems at HPC Universitas Gunadarma and analytics pipelines at Tunas Group.
Work spans industrial predictive maintenance and peer-reviewed coral research (89% classification accuracy).
Uses PEFT/QLoRA, FastAPI, Docker, and cloud platforms; has taught AI/ML to 200+ learners.
